items.title: RJ Brunelli Brokers Sale of The Gardens Shopping Center in Morris County, N.J.
items.summary: RJ Brunelli & Co. today announced that it has brokered the sale of the 100% fee simple interest in The Gardens, a 210,845-square-foot shopping center in the Flanders section of Mt. Olive Township. Located at the intersection of Routes 46 and 80, the Morris County power center was acquired for $41 million by Bronstein Properties, LLC from Rivani.
